# Duhita Multispeciality Dental Centre (Duhita Dental)

> Specialist-led multispeciality dental hospital in Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, India, caring for patients since 1997. Founded by
> Dr. Nalluru Sasidhar, BDS, MDS (Conservative Dentistry), endodontist and implantologist with 32+ years of experience.

- Address: 1st Floor, D.No 59, Shanthi Plaza, 14-2/1, above SBI NRI Branch, Gayatri Nagar, Krishna Nagar, near Benz Circle, Vijayawada 520010, Andhra Pradesh
- Phone: 0866 247 4066 · Email: duhitadent@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 10:00 AM–1:00 PM and 4:30 PM–8:00 PM; Sunday by appointment
- Google reviews: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=15016988245437128456

## Specialities

- [Endodontics — root canal treatment, fillings, broken teeth](https://duhitadental.com/services/endodontics)
- [Prosthodontics — dental implants, crowns, bridges, dentures, veneers](https://duhitadental.com/services/prosthodontics)
- [Orthodontics — braces and clear aligners](https://duhitadental.com/services/orthodontics)
- [Pedodontics — children's dentistry](https://duhitadental.com/services/pedodontics)
- [Periodontics — gum treatment](https://duhitadental.com/services/periodontics)
- [Oral and maxillofacial surgery — wisdom teeth, extractions](https://duhitadental.com/services/oral-surgery)
- [Oral medicine — digital X-rays, 3D scans, oral cancer screening](https://duhitadental.com/services/oral-medicine)
